patch_description:
Replace the over-parameterized fixed structure with an efficient ansatz that uses:
1. Shared parameters across qubits to reduce the parameter count from 162 to ~50-60
2. Parametrized two-qubit gates (CRZ) on allowed pairs instead of fixed CZ gates
3. Strategic three-qubit gates (ZZZ) on subsets of qubits for expressivity
4. Consolidated single-qubit rotations

This should reduce overfitting (smaller train-test gap), improve generalization, and maintain or improve accuracy through more efficient parameter usage.
